oil_life_monitor: The vehicle is equipped with an Oil Control System (OCS) that calculates engine oil and filter change intervals based on driving conditions. Light conditions (freeway driving, city driving on flat/moderate hills, no towing, no extended idling) result in normal display timing. Extreme conditions (repeated short trips under 5 miles, short trips under 10 miles in below-freezing temps, hot weather stop-and-go traffic, extensive idling/low-speed driving, towing/camper/car-top carrier, frequent braking/mountainous driving, sustained high-speed driving) result in early display timing. If the oil replacement indicator is displayed, change the engine oil within two weeks or less than 500 miles (800 km). If the indicator resets prematurely or becomes inoperative, change oil within six months or 3,750 miles (6,000 km) from last oil change.
severe_conditions: Repeated short trips of less than 5 miles (8 km)
Repeated short trips of less than 10 miles (16 km) with outside temperatures remaining below freezing
Operating in hot weather in stop-and-go 'rush hour' traffic
Extensive idling and/or low speed driving for long distances, such as police, taxi or door-to-door delivery use
Driving on rough, muddy or salt spread roads
extraction_caveats:
1. The maintenance schedule header on page 557 states 'up to 120,000 miles (192,000 km)/96 months' and 'After 120,000 miles (192,000 km)/96 months, continue maintenance at the same mileage/time interval.' Page 559 states 'After 90,000 miles (144,000 km)/144 months, continue maintenance at the same mileage/time interval.' The schedule pages provided cover through 90,000 miles/144 months.
2. Tire rotation appears at every 3,750-mile/6-month interval in the standard maintenance essentials columns (pages 559-570), giving a repeat cadence of 3,750 miles/6 months.
3. Engine coolant replacement interval (105,000 miles/7 years) is stated in the do-it-yourself section (page 514) and referenced in the maintenance section text (page 555), but no explicit mileage column for coolant replacement appears in the schedule pages provided. The first_at_miles/first_at_months fields are used to capture this.
4. Intercooler coolant is described as 'maintenance-free' (page 556); no replacement interval is scheduled.
5. Fuel filter: 'Periodic maintenance is not required (in-tank type filter)' (page 556) — not included in maintenance items.
6. Engine valve clearance*: 'Inspect only if valve noise increases' (page 556) — condition-based, not interval-based; omitted from scheduled items.
7. Items marked with '*' (engine drive belts, engine coolant, fuel tank vapor vent system, fuel lines/connections, engine valve clearance) are recommended by NISSAN but not required for warranty maintenance.
8. CVT fluid capacity not provided on the pages supplied.
9. In-cabin microfilter appears at a consistent 11,250-mile/18-month interval throughout the schedule (11,250, 22,500, 33,750, 45,000, 56,250, 67,500, 78,750, 90,000).
10. Intelligent Key battery is listed as 'Inspect' at 11,250 miles and 'Replace' starting at 22,500 miles, then replace every 11,250 miles/18 months thereafter.
11. Engine drive belts first appear at 30,000 miles, then repeat every 7,500 miles/12 months (30k, 37.5k, 45k, 52.5k, 60k, 67.5k, 75k, 82.5k, 90k).
12. Page 406 was removed from source_pages as it contains ProPILOT Assist information unrelated to maintenance.
